check: thread and handle growth across four hours

threadTrend.whyChecked: Threads held flat at 33 from hour 0.86 through hour 4, having settled from 34 at startup. This was a real risk to check because the refill loop creates futures every 17 to 25 minutes, so an accumulating thread per refill would have been invisible until the process ran out.

openFilesField.cause: openFiles reads -1 because countOpenFiles lists /proc/self/fd, a Linux path that does not exist on Windows, and the method returns -1 when the directory is absent. It is a documented platform limit, not a missing measurement.
openFilesField.classification: platform limit, already the same class as the symlink limitation recorded in the ledger's environmentLimits

notDone: No thread dump was taken, deliberately: attaching to the live JVM would disturb the profile, and the checkpoint already answers the question the dump would - whether the count grows.
